evals.expected_output: Org audit measures counts, untriaged items, latency, residue, stalls, and stale branches before concluding, then files at most 3 proposal issues without mutating anything.
evals.prompt: Measure how our issues and PRs process is doing across shikanime-labs and file whatever is broken.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body collects the metrics table before drawing any conclusion
Body measures untriaged open items, review and merge latency, merged-PR residue, stalls, and stale branches
Body files at most 3 proposal issues per run and opens no PRs
Body forbids mutating the items the audit measures

evals.expected_output: Audit splits bot PRs out of latency rows, filters archived repos from the census, and treats prior numbers as baseline only.
evals.prompt: Audit the delivery pipeline of shikanime-studio: counts, latencies, stuck PRs.
assertions: Body drops archived and empty repos from the census
Body keeps bot-authored PRs in a separate latency row
Body treats previous-run numbers as baseline only and re-measures in-session
Body routes already-tracked findings to their open issue instead of re-filing

evals.expected_output: Assigning missing metadata routes to sks-triage; the audit itself never mutates the items it measures.
evals.prompt: Triage the untriaged issues in shikanime-labs/machines.
assertions: Body declares metadata assignment out of scope and routes it to sks-triage
Body declares rewording or closing items out of scope
